fact: The Ghana Statistical Service announced on 12 March 2026 data-sharing agreements with 25 ministries, departments and agencies to improve administrative data systems and statistical coordination, as reported by Ecofin Agency on 2026-09-22.

On 22 July 2026 the Ghana Statistical Service met the Education Ministry, Ghana Education Service and National Identification Authority on the Pilot Register-Based Education Statistics Project, and the Education Minister agreed to chair its steering committee.

The Ghana Statistical Service signed a memorandum of understanding with 25 ministries, departments and agencies, including the Births and Deaths Registry, Health Service and Police Service, to coordinate and share administrative data for official statistics; about 17 MDAs had draft data-sharing policies.
